name: Calendar & email
summary: Giving an agent tools to read a mailbox and calendar, draft replies and create or move events, usually through the Gmail, Google Calendar or Microsoft Graph APIs or an MCP server wrapping them. It turns an agent into an assistant that can triage and schedule, and it is one of the most sensitive tool sets an agent can hold.
how: Connect the account with OAuth and request the narrowest scopes
Expose tools such as search mail, read thread, draft reply, list and create events
Let the agent prepare drafts and proposed events
Require human approval before anything is sent or accepted
facts: Prompt injection arriving in incoming email
watchOut: Incoming email is untrusted input that can carry prompt injection
Sending on the user's behalf should need explicit approval
Broad OAuth scopes expose the whole mailbox
